summary.text: Jason Ray Clark, a Republican who according to BallotReady is a West Point graduate and founder of an investment firm and a financial coaching business, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House seat in Colorado's 6th District to Jason Crow.
He advanced from the June 30, 2026 Republican primary with no other Republican candidate in the primary, and his BallotReady profile lists public safety and the cost of living among his issues.

paragraphs.text: According to BallotReady, Clark graduated from Smoky Hill High School in 1988 and earned an engineering bachelor's degree from the U.S. Military Academy at West Point in 1992.
His campaign website says he grew up in Colorado's 6th District and attended Sagebrush Elementary, Laredo Middle School and Smoky Hill High School.

BallotReady lists him as founder of Clark Brothers Investments (2007-2023) and The Buffett Way Financial Coaching (2023-2025), and his campaign website says he has been an entrepreneur and small business owner in Aurora, Colorado, for more than 30 years.
Clark advanced from the June 30, 2026 Republican primary for the 6th District as the only candidate on the ballot, with 38,437 votes.
He received 31.1% of the vote to Jason Crow's 65.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
